name: MFA fatigue — repeated MFA prompts
kql: SigninLogs | where ResultType != '0' | summarize failures=count() by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m) | where failures >= 5
spl: index=o365 sourcetype=o365:management:activity Operation=UserLoginFailed | stats count by user | where count > 5
tuning: Multiple 'approve' demands = fatigue; require number matching / conditional access.
